Recognize the benefits of AI in specialized domains like coding and sound.
outline: Welcome to Code and Audio Generation.

AI's Expanding Creativity: Beyond Text and Images.
How AI Tools Enhance Developer Productivity.
Code Generation: Your Smart Developer Assistant.
AI for Music Creation and Composition.
Audio Generation: The AI Sound Wizards.
prerequisites: Familiarity with basic concepts of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Understanding of how AI works with text and images.

slides.title: Code and Audio Generation: AI's Specialized Skills
slides.narration:
Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial.
It is about Code and Audio Generation.
slides.image_prompt: A futuristic banner with 'Code and Audio Generation' prominently displayed, showing abstract representations of code lines and sound waves.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn many things.
You will understand **AI** in code creation.
You will identify **AI**'s audio applications.
You will recognize **AI**'s benefits in these domains.
slides.image_prompt: A bulleted list icon with gears and sound waves, representing code and audio, next to a checklist.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration:
You will need a web browser.
Use Firefox or Chrome.
You need a stable internet connection.
No software installation is needed.
slides.image_prompt: Icons representing a web browser, Wi-Fi signal, and a desktop computer.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration:
To follow this tutorial, you must know **AI** basics.
You should know **Machine Learning** concepts.
You must understand **AI** with text and images.
slides.image_prompt: A stack of books or building blocks representing foundational knowledge, with 'AI Basics' written on them.

slides.title: AI's Expanding Creativity: Beyond Text and Images
slides.narration:
Have you spent hours debugging code?
Think about it.
Do you need music for a video?
Is it hard to find the right track?
**Generative AI** is mastering complex domains.
It goes beyond text and images.
It steps into programming and sound.
slides.image_prompt: A robot hand typing code on one side and a robot hand conducting an orchestra on the other, symbolizing AI's reach into new domains.

slides.title: Code Generation: Your Developer's Assistant
slides.narration:
Imagine a coding partner.
It knows billions of code lines.
Tools like **GitHub Copilot** exist.
They are **AI** models.
They train on vast public code.
They act as a smart assistant.
They do not replace human programmers.
slides.image_prompt: A developer working at a computer, with a holographic AI assistant figure peering over their shoulder, suggesting code.

slides.title: Boosting Productivity with AI Code Generation
slides.narration:
How does this **AI** assistant help you?
Think about it.
It suggests code as you type.
It translates comments into code.
It helps you find bugs faster.
It helps you fix bugs faster.
This makes developers quicker.
It makes them more efficient.
slides.image_prompt: A split screen showing a code editor. On one side, a human types, and on the other, AI suggestions appear, with arrows indicating increased speed and efficiency.

slides.title: Code Generation: Your Smart Pair Programmer
slides.narration:
Think of **AI** code generation.
It is like a pair programmer.
This programmer is highly experienced.
It knows common patterns.
It knows common solutions.
It anticipates your needs.
It offers suggestions quickly.
It is an encyclopedia of code.
It guides you constantly.
slides.image_prompt: Two people (one human, one stylized AI figure) sitting side-by-side at a computer, collaboratively coding.

slides.title: Audio Generation: Crafting Sounds with AI
slides.narration:
**AI** masters more than visuals.
It masters more than text.
**AI** is now a master of sound.
These models train on vast datasets.
They use sounds and human voices.
They use diverse music.
They learn audio patterns.
They generate audio patterns.
slides.image_prompt: Abstract sound waves transforming into recognizable audio elements like a microphone, musical notes, and headphones.

slides.title: Realistic Voices: AI Voice Synthesis
slides.narration:
What can **AI** do with audio?
Think about it.
It creates realistic voices.
These voices are human-like.
This is **voice synthesis**.
It is also **text-to-speech**.
Use it for audiobooks.
Use it for podcasts.
Use it for virtual assistants.
The voices sound real.
slides.image_prompt: A microphone icon with sound waves emanating from it, transforming into text bubbles for audiobooks and a virtual assistant avatar.

slides.title: AI as a Musical Composer
slides.narration:
**AI** can also compose music.
It generates background music.
This music is royalty-free.
Use it for videos.
Use it for presentations.
It creates new melodies.
It creates new harmonies.
Some **AI** models generate songs.
They match a famous artist's style.
They match a specific genre.
slides.image_prompt: A musical staff with AI elements, notes flowing from a computer screen, and a diverse range of musical instruments.

slides.title: Audio Generation: The AI Sound Wizards
slides.narration:
Consider **AI** audio generation.
It is a team of sound wizards.
They conjure any voice you need.
The voices are perfectly articulate.
They compose entire symphonies.
They do it on demand.
It is a virtual recording studio.
It is a master composer.
Both are available instantly.
slides.image_prompt: A stylized wizard figure with musical notes and sound waves swirling around its hands, creating a magical auditory scene.

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
We explored **generative AI**.
It extends to code and audio.
Code generation tools are smart assistants.
**GitHub Copilot** is one example.
They boost developer efficiency.
They suggest code.
They find bugs.
Audio generation creates realistic voices.
This is **voice synthesis**.
It composes new music.
It creates soundscapes.
slides.image_prompt: A concise infographic summarizing code generation and audio generation with icons for each.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
Think about a coding task.
Do you perform it often?
Pause and consider.
Research a free **AI** code tool.
Find a plugin for your **IDE**.
Try using it for that task.
Automate it or get assistance.
Reflect on your workflow.
Did it change your efficiency?
